title: Creatio Named a Pioneer in Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant for No-Code Agent Builders, October 2026
summary: Creatio AI Studio enables organizations to build, run and govern AI agents that power business-critical workflows
body_markdown:
Creatio, an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together, today announced it has been recognized as a Pioneer in the Gartner Emerging Market Quadrant for No-Code Agent Builders — Established Vendors.


The report helps readers understand the evolving no-code agent builder market and the vendors shaping it. It explores tools that enable business users to build and deploy AI agents without deep technical or coding expertise, as organizations consider a broader role for employee-built agents.


For Creatio, making agent development accessible is part of a broader effort to change how enterprise software is built and how work gets done.


Creatio AI Studio enables organizations to build, run, and govern AI agents for business-critical workflows using no-code tools. By combining no-code development with agentic AI, organizations can move beyond isolated AI tasks to automate entire business processes, empowering business teams to create and evolve solutions without traditional development.


Creatio AI Studio Twin lets employees create personal agents by describing what they need in natural language, while enterprise teams can build agents for more complex workflows. Connected to business data and systems, these agents operate within shared governance controls.


“We believe enterprise software needs a fundamental rethink, from who can build it to how work gets done. No-code transformed who can create business applications, and agentic AI takes this even further. With Creatio AI Studio, we’re bringing these worlds together, empowering business users to build AI agents that act on enterprise data and automate critical workflows. This is where we see the opportunity to disrupt: giving more people the power to transform how their organizations operate, with enterprise-grade governance built in," said Burley Kawasaki, SVP of Industries, Creatio.


We believe this builds on Creatio’s longstanding focus on no-code development, extending the ability to create applications and workflows to building and managing AI agents on the same platform.


[Download a complimentary copy of the report](https://www.creatio.com/page/gartner-no-code-agent-builders-2026) to explore Gartner analysis of the no-code agent builder market.


Learn more about Creatio AI Studio at[creatio.com/ai-studio](https://www.creatio.com/ai-studio) .
